cards.title: XY Hamiltonian in the zero/single-excitation sector

checks.detail: The onsite and nearest-neighbour coefficients are explicitly defined.
The XY exchange preserves excitation number, making the zero/single-excitation restriction exact.

open_questions: Main Eq. (1) repeats a lowering term; Hermiticity fixes the conjugate exchange term.

cards.title: Zig-zag PST onsite energies, couplings and spectrum
cards.statement: omega_n=2mJ on even n and 0 on odd n (parity-corrected Eq. 8); J_n=(J/2)sqrt[(n+2m mu_n)(N-n+2m mu_(n+1))] with the printed odd-site mu in Eq. 9

checks.detail: The target spectrum, Fig. 1, even-site suppression claim and Supplementary Schur elimination jointly fix the parity typo in Eq. (8).
With 2mJ on even sites and the printed Eq. (9) couplings, direct diagonalization exactly gives {...,-1,0,2m+1,...}J and the correct Hamiltonian trace.
At m=0 the Christandl chain and tau=pi/J give unit endpoint transfer.

open_questions: Main Eq. (8) defines mu_n on odd sites, but every independent physical cross-check requires the onsite parity to be even; this is treated as a source typo and preserved as an explicit finding.

cards.title: Closed-form three-site populations

checks.detail: P_Q1, P_Q2 and P_Q3 are printed in closed form.
The three populations sum to one for arbitrary real Delta, J and t.
The formula equals direct exponentiation of the printed 3x3 matrix.

open_questions: The Supplement does not publish the chip's coupler-frequency-to-J transfer function used by Fig. S2.

cards.title: Isospectral FST deformation
cards.statement: J_left -> (cos theta+sin theta)J_left; J_right -> (cos theta-sin theta)J_right

checks.detail: The two central-coupling multipliers for odd N are explicit.
The deformed and PST matrices have identical eigenvalues.
theta=pi/8 gives one-half population at both endpoints at tau=pi/J.

open_questions: The printed endpoint plus sign and named Bell singlet differ by an unreported local phase gauge.

cards.title: Separable two-dimensional FST extension
cards.statement: H_2D = H_x tensor I + I tensor H_y

checks.detail: The source states that the one-dimensional FST condition is imposed along both dimensions.
The Kronecker-sum propagator factorizes into the two one-dimensional propagators.
At theta=pi/8 the four corner probabilities are each one quarter.

open_questions: The main 3x3 experiment does not report m or a complete matrix, so the separable construction is explicit reconstruction.

cards.title: Independent relaxation/dephasing Lindblad dynamics

checks.detail: T1, T2/Tphi and collapse-operator forms are printed.
The constructed Liouvillian preserves trace and Hermiticity.
Infinite T1,Tphi reduces to unitary evolution.

open_questions: The summation notation is interpreted as independent per-qubit collapse channels, not collective noise.

cards.title: Static Gaussian parameter-noise ensemble
cards.statement: delta lambda_n sampled independently from Normal(0,sigma); report mean and standard deviation of F/F0

checks.detail: Noise families, Gaussian law and sample counts 50/100 are explicit.
Zero noise gives F/F0=1 for every m.

open_questions: The random seeds and exact scan arrays are not reported; deterministic replacements are declared in config.

cards.title: Large-m elimination of even sites

checks.detail: The final effective onsite energy and coupling are explicit.
A Schur complement of the even subspace gives the printed large-m limit.

open_questions: An intermediate Supplement equation has mismatched site indices; the final formulas are consistent.

cards.title: Effective flattop-Gaussian pulse reconstruction

checks.detail: The physical sigma and buffer values are printed, but the control-to-Hamiltonian transfer functions are absent.
The shared effective envelope preserves the target Hamiltonian ratios and nominal pulse area.
Acceptance requires agreement with the three reported Fig. S9 fidelity anchors within the declared reconstructed tolerance.

open_questions: Separate physical qubit/coupler envelopes cannot be converted into effective omega_n(t),J_n(t) without calibration transfer functions.
